notes: Checked-in ElevenLabs prompt set for `launchclip sfx seed`. Each family: prompt, duration_seconds (the API minimum is 0.5), prompt_influence (0-1; higher follows the prompt more literally), variants (generations per family) and optional keep (files kept; a harvest family may keep several clean single hits from one generation). Post-processing trims every clip to its family's length, so short sounds are requested at the 0.5 s minimum.

whoosh.prompt: single soft cinematic whoosh, short air swish passing quickly left to right, clean, no reverb tail, no music

impact.prompt: single deep cinematic impact hit, punchy low body thump with a crisp click transient, short natural tail, one hit only, no music

riser.prompt: short cinematic tension riser, rising pitch and brightening noise building to a sudden stop at its loudest point, no impact at the end, no music

tick.prompt: single soft user interface tick, tiny dry wooden click, close mic, one tick only

pop.prompt: single soft bubbly user interface pop, clean and dry, close mic, one pop only

shimmer.prompt: short bright magical shimmer, glassy bell sparkle that resolves gently, clean, no music, no voice

subdrop.prompt: deep sub bass drop, smooth low boom sweeping down in pitch, cinematic, clean, no music

click.prompt: single crisp modern user interface button click, dry, close mic, one click only

keystroke.prompt: single mechanical keyboard key press, cherry blue switch, close mic, dry, one keystroke only

keystroke-space.prompt: single mechanical keyboard space bar press, heavy stabilised spacebar thock, close mic, dry, one press only

keystroke-enter.prompt: single mechanical keyboard enter key press, firm heavy keystroke, close mic, dry, one press only
